about_the_game:
In the recently abandoned village of NaniNani Mura, the last in a lineage of pure monks named Chado-san searches for answers about why he was sent away to Tokyo as a child, why the residents have all fled, and what happened to the beautiful child hood friend he remembers fondly. However a legendary Spirit haunts the village and is hunting your pure energy! Protect Chado-san's purity and find a way to escape Hachishaku's grasp!

Hachishaku is a stalker horror style game where you investigate the village, find answers, collect money, and buy various costumes, accessories and hair styles for your 8 foot tall stalker. Escape the village, Get spirited away, or confront your duty! 

The game includes 10 costumes, 6 hair styles, and plenty of accessories to save your coins for at launch, but more will be considered and added in the future! After beating the game you can also enjoy the Gravure Mode and enjoy a peaceful life with Hachishaku in her secret hideout.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a light ecchi waifu game. There is no nudity or explicit sexual content but there is a lot of sexy and slightly lewd costumes and jiggle physics. I

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel I7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please make sure to force DX 11 through the steam launch settings to prevent crashing
